data:text/html,<style>body{margin:0;background:%23111}canvas{display:block;margin:auto}.cube{width:80px;height:80px;margin:60px auto;background:%233498db;transform-style:preserve-3d;animation:spin 4s linear infinite;box-shadow:0 0 20px %233498db}@keyframes spin{from{transform:perspective(400px) rotateY(0)}to{transform:perspective(400px) rotateY(360deg)}}</style><canvas id="c" width="400" height="300"></canvas><div class="cube"></div><script>const e=document.getElementById("c"),t=e.getContext("2d");let n;const i={1:["sawtooth",450,800,500,.7],2:["sawtooth",800,1300,900,.35],3:["sawtooth",350,700,300,1.4],4:["sawtooth",300,600,650,.3],5:["sawtooth",90,90,70,1],6:["triangle",600,1e3,600,.8],7:["sine",1500,2e3,1800,.2],8:["square",500,1e3,400,1],9:["sawtooth",700,500,300,1],0:["triangle",60,60,50,1.5]};function o(n){t.fillStyle="%23111",t.fillRect(0,0,e.width,e.height),t.fillStyle="%23fff",t.font="120px sans-serif",t.textAlign="center",t.textBaseline="middle",t.fillText(n,e.width/2,e.height/2)}document.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{const t=i[e.key];t&&!e.repeat&&(function([e,t,i,o,a]){n=n||new AudioContext;const l=n.currentTime,s=n.createOscillator(),c=n.createGain();s.type=e,s.frequency.setValueAtTime(t,l),s.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(i,l+.3*a),s.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(o,l+a),c.gain.setValueAtTime(.3,l),c.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0,l+a),s.connect(c).connect(n.destination),s.start(l),s.stop(l+a)}(t),o(e.key))}),o("type 0-9");</script>
